capabilities: Roll unfinished tasks from the previous daily note into the latest one
Track routine task streaks using leading {id} tokens
Carry pinned wikilinks forward between daily notes
Write prev/next pagination links to adjacent daily notes
Collect links to notes created or edited today
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README only covers install from GitHub releases or building from source, with no usage examples. A "Sync wait" setting suggests it can coordinate with Obsidian Sync.
problem: Obsidian daily notes are standalone files, so unfinished tasks, pinned links, and routine tracking don't automatically carry over to the next day's note.
summary: Daily-notes plugin that rolls unfinished todos, pinned links, and routine streaks forward and writes prev/next pagination links between notes.
